heading: **22 May 2026**
body:
*PE Phusion Mix (16X)*

| PE Phusion Mix |  |  |  |
| ----- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Reagents | per well in 384 | per 384-well plate | for 16 plates |
| MQ water | 2.39642μL | 1055.25 μL | 16884 μL |
| 5x Phusion HF buffer | 2.47818μL | 1091.25 μL | 17460 μL |
| 10mM dNTP | 0.48542μL | 213.75 μL | 3420 μL |
| MgCl2 (50mM) | 0.49819μL | 219.375 μL | 3510 μL |
| HF Phusion DNA Pol (2U/µL) | 0.14179μL | 62.4375 μL | 999 μL |
| Total | 6μL | 2642.0625 μL | 42.273 mL |

Add 10 uL of 100 uM PE\_F primer per 1 mL of primer mix.

*PE PCR*

Now, 6 flow-cells will be used instead for sequencing the following samples:

Tube 1: \[C1\_HTS\_lig200 (PE0) \+ C1\_NCAP\_lig200 (PE1)\]  
Tube 2: \[C1\_HTS\_lig147 (PE0) \+ C1\_NCAP\_lig147 (PE1)\]  
Tube 3: \[C3\_HTS\_lig200 (PE2) \+ C3\_NCAP\_lig200 (PE3)\]  
Tube 4: \[C3\_HTS\_lig147 (PE2) \+ C3\_NCAP\_lig147 (PE3)\]  
Tube 5: \[C4\_HTS\_lig200 (PE2) \+ C4\_NCAP\_lig200 (PE3)\]  
Tube 6: \[C4\_HTS\_lig147 (PE0) \+ C4\_NCAP\_lig147 (PE1)\]
